_why: A file listed here declares tests and contains no expect(, and that is CORRECT for it. Each entry must say why. A count-only baseline would excuse the same files silently and would also excuse the next one added by accident; a named list with a reason cannot. The linter fails if a listed file no longer exists, or no longer violates the rule, so this file cannot rot into permission. 2026-08-21, integrating eleven lanes: design-audit.spec.ts was removed from this list. wt-hollow declared it assertionless ("there is nothing for it to assert") and that was true on wt-hollow's tree. wt-screens had meanwhile given it something worth asserting — expect(written).toBeGreaterThan(0), the check that the camera actually WROTE frames rather than filing an empty run as evidence. So the exception had become a lie, the stale-exception rule caught it, and the entry is deleted rather than the assertion.
